property_summary: For any caller and any uint value, calling SetMinSum on C after Initialized() always reverts; the reference revert() produces a revert without a reason string while the mutant uses require(false, "already initialized") which returns a revert with a reason string — observing whether the call returns a reason string (via try/catch bytes) distinguishes the mutant from the reference.
change_summary: Change revert() to require(false) with a message (semantically reverts but with different bytecode; observable difference in revert reason string).
